title: Australian AI infrastructure developer Firmus lands $10 billion debt package from Blackstone, Coatue
title_zh: 澳大利亚人工智能基础设施开发商 Firmus 从 Blackstone 和 Coatue 获得 100 亿美元的债务计划
summary: Australian artificial intelligence company Firmus said on Monday ​it had finalised a $10 billion debt funding ‌package led by global private equity firm Blackstone and Coatue ‌Management, a New York-based technology investor.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚人工智能公司 Firmus 周一表示，已敲定由全球私募股权公司 Blackstone 和纽约科技投资者 Coatue Management 牵头的 100 亿美元债务融资方案。

title: Goldman Traders Warn Stock Selling Isn’t Over in Choppy Market
title_zh: 高盛交易员警告称，在动荡的市场中，股票抛售尚未结束
summary: The S&P 500 Index has already breached its short-term trigger that prompted Commodity Trading Advisers, or CTAs, to sell stocks.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数已经突破了促使商品交易顾问 (CTA) 出售股票的短期触发点。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise with Wall Street looking to continue Dow 50,000 rally
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标普 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨，华尔街预计道指将延续 50,000 点涨势
summary: Major gauge futures are rising ahead of a week defined by jobs and inflation reports.
summary_zh: 主要指标期货在就业和通胀报告定义的一周之前上涨。

title: SpaceX prioritizes lunar 'self-growing city' over Mars project, Musk says
title_zh: 马斯克表示，SpaceX 优先考虑月球“自我成长城市”而不是火星项目
summary: Elon Musk said on Sunday that SpaceX has shifted its focus to building a "self‑growing city" on the moon, which could be achieved in less ​than 10 years.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克周日表示，SpaceX 已将重点转向在月球上建设一座“自我成长的城市”，这可能在不到 10 年内实现。

title: Why I am still taking these tech stocks to task
title_zh: 为什么我仍然对这些科技股持批评态度
summary: Tech stocks are not getting any love from me after a wild week.
summary_zh: 经过疯狂的一周后，科技股并没有得到我的任何喜爱。

title: Dow 50,000 sets table for inflation data, delayed January jobs report: What to watch this week
title_zh: 道指 50,000 点为通胀数据奠定基础，推迟 1 月份就业报告：本周关注点
summary: As investors turn toward the coming week, Wall Street will look to build on Friday's sharp turnaround into the green as investors process the drastic software and crypto sell-off.
summary_zh: 随着投资者转向未来一周，随着投资者处理软件和加密货币的大幅抛售，华尔街将寻求在周五的急剧转向绿色基础上继续前进。

title: Big Tech companies are starting to look like IBM in the 1960s
title_zh: 大型科技公司开始变得像 20 世纪 60 年代的 IBM
summary: The race to dominate the burgeoning AI market is pushing tech giants to adopt business models reminiscent of IBM's in the 1960s.
summary_zh: 为了主导新兴的人工智能市场，科技巨头纷纷采用让人想起 20 世纪 60 年代 IBM 的商业模式。

title: Consumer Reports' 2026 top 10 cars all have one important feature
title_zh: 《消费者报告》2026 年十大汽车都有一个重要特征
summary: Consumer Reports' top 10 best new cars for 2026 all feature one important feature: hybrid or fully electric power.
summary_zh: 《消费者报告》评选的 2026 年 10 款最佳新车均具有一个重要特征：混合动力或全电动。
